_options._note: LLM-originated intraday (MIS) agent -- the intraday counterpart of llm_swing_agent, NOT a chart-pattern strategy. Ideas come from src/strategies/llm_intraday/pipeline.py, run by src/orchestrator.py's _llm_intraday_agent_loop at config/global.json llm_intraday.decision_times_ist and published to shared['llm_intraday_ideas']; the 5-minute intraday scan turns a still-fresh idea into a Signal via _evaluate_llm_intraday_signal (same pattern as news_catalyst_momentum), so it rides the normal ranked placement -> _execute_intraday_signal -> CRM G0-G10 path, with an independent fail-closed G9 reviewer (llm.intraday_g9). The entry_conditions below are deliberately impossible so this spec is inert in the per-bar scan. stop_loss/target are NOT used -- the LLM proposes its own levels, bounded by the llm_intraday validation limits. exit_conditions ARE used: SmartExitTracker applies breakeven at 1R and an ATR trail from 1.5R, with NO partial booking (orb_intraday_smart's 50% partial at 1R capped realised payoff at 1.03:1 vs 2.13:1 planned). 2026-09-22: added giveback_lock (once MFE >= 0.5R the stop holds half of MFE) and time_decay (breakeven from 14:15 if MFE >= 0.3R; max -0.5R loss from 14:45) after HOMEFIRST/TATACHEM went 0.5R+ green and were force-exited red. Replay (scripts/replay_intraday_exits.py, 409 closed MIS trades, 0.10% cost): expectancy -0.808R -> -0.784R, green-then-red 75 -> 60 of 141, avg win 0.42R -> 0.32R. Marginal help; it does not fix entries. Forward pass/fail count restarts 2026-09-23 so old and new exit regimes are not mixed.
